description: Three-key fingerprints (raw_sha256, content_sha256, content_shape) over the 1,754 Dataset059_s1_s4_s5_patches_frangiedt pairs as held locally since a July 2026 pair-download. Download artifacts (the servers own nnUNet dataset.json with numTraining 1754, a pair-fetch log, and label files that can only originate from the dataset) indicate these are the server bytes as stored; an earlier description of them as re-extractions was wrong and is corrected in the villa #191 thread. Mixed stored shapes (172/236/300 cubed) are the datasets own geometry. Zero content matches against the public Kaggle sets 892 volumes therefore indicates the public set is not a repacking of this dataset. Keys follow TAUIL-Abd-Elilah/vesuvius-repro.
